edits.old: No credential and no personal name appears in the request, the row, the workflow input, the record or the logs. Where a person must be named the row carries the user identifier, never a name, and the masking of the personal fields of the case is the platform edge's.
edits.new: No credential and no personal name appears in the request, the row, the workflow input, the record or the logs. Where a person must be named the row carries the user identifier, which is classed as personal data, never a name, and the masking of the personal fields of the case is the platform edge's. Each REST operation is guarded by the rwb-access authorise check (DP-08); this service writes no check of its own.
